# Let's Advance Biomedical Discovery Together

Scientific progress is driven by collaboration across disciplines, institutions, and perspectives.

I welcome conversations with researchers, principal investigators, students, clinicians, and industry scientists who share an interest in computational biology, artificial intelligence, and data-driven biomedical discovery.

Whether the discussion involves collaborative research, graduate opportunities, computational methods, or open science, I am always interested in exchanging ideas that have the potential to advance meaningful scientific work.

## A Philosophy of Collaboration

I believe that the most impactful scientific advances emerge when complementary expertise converges around important questions.

I value collaborations characterized by intellectual curiosity, methodological rigor, openness, and a shared commitment to reproducible and impactful research.

## Get in Touch

If my research interests align with yours, I would be delighted to connect.

Whether you would like to discuss research ideas, potential collaborations, graduate opportunities, invited talks, open-source initiatives, or interdisciplinary projects, please feel free to reach out.

I look forward to contributing to scientific discoveries that improve our understanding of biology and ultimately benefit human health.
